sourceText:
Cranberry Waldorf Salad
By: Candy Evavold
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:06pm

Ingredients




2 cups chopped pears
2 cups chopped apples
1 cup seedless grapes, halved
1 cup sliced celery
2/3 cup broken walnuts or broken pecans
1/2 cup snipped pitted whole dates, raisins or dried cranberries
2/3 cup whole cranberry sauce
1/2 cup sweetened whipped cream
1/4 cup dairy sour cream
Leaf lettuce

Preparation

1 In a medium mixing bowl combine chopped pears, apples, grapes, celery, walnuts or pecans, and dates, raisins or dried cranberries. Divide fruit mixture among lettuce-lined salad plates. 2 For dressing, in a small mixing bowl combine cranberry sauce and sour cream. Fold in sweetened whipped cream. Drizzle dressing over fruit mixture.
